stops.note: a plain word for a flat board or writing tablet
plus the diminutive suffix -eau, coined for a small painted panel
stops.meaning: a slab; a small picture panel

stops.note: settled into the general word for a picture or painting
borrowed for a vivid, picture-like scene or grouping of figures
stops.meaning: a vivid, picturesque scene or description

current_meaning: a vivid or graphic depiction of a scene, or a group of motionless figures representing one
